messages:
elaine: Heads-up — release cutoff in ~48h (Fri 10 AM PT). Please add changelog entries before EOD tomorrow. Use the template: https://go/redwood/changelog-template :memo:

mira: quick q — are we bumping minor or patch? last release was 1.13.0

jon: bump minor -> 1.14.0. runtime batching & KV cache changes warrant a minor.

kevin: +1 from infra. also add component tags like [runtime], [console], [api] so release notes are grouped.

mira: where should I put the component tag? frontmatter or the first line?

jon: first line. e.g. `[runtime] Improve KV cache eviction for long sessions — avoids OOMs`

elaine: quick lint tip: run the changelog linter locally before opening the PR: `npx @redwood/changelog-lint ./changelog/ENTRY.md` — it checks subject style and component tags.

changelog-bot: lint failed on `changelog/2026-11-17-mira-eviction.md`: missing component tag :x:

mira: fixing now, thanks for the heads up.

kevin: if this needs backporting, target branch `release/1.14.x`. add a "Backport" section in the body and mention the branch in the PR description.

mira: done — pushed update and added backport notes. pinging @jon @kevin for review.

jon: will review this afternoon. note for the release engineer: after changelogs are merged we'll run `scripts/bump-version --minor` and then cut the release branch.

elaine: formatting reminder — keep the subject imperative and <= 80 chars. body can include GH refs like `(GH#1234)` but put them in the body not the subject.

mira: updated PR, included body with repro, benchmarks, and backport checklist.

changelog-bot: lint OK :white_check_mark:

kevin: great. final checklist for tomorrow: changelog merged, PR approved, CI green, release branch up-to-date. I'll handle the bump and cut once that's met.

elaine: thanks everyone — I'll post final release announce tomorrow AM. :partyparrot:
